guide.goal: 國中教育會考精熟級 (A++) 雙向細目：現在完成式、被動語態、關係代名詞子句、名詞子句與多模態圖表題。
guide.motivation: 現在完成式 (have/has + pp) 與被動語態 (be + pp) 是九年級三大高分文法重鎮，佔會考選擇題 35% 考點！

tips.title: 現在完成式指標詞：since vs for
tips.formula: have/has + p.p. + since + 過去時間點 (since 2020) / have/has + p.p. + for + 一段時間 (for three years)
tips.body: since 接時間起點 (since yesterday, since he arrived)；for 接一段時間長度 (for 10 years)。
tips.example: I have lived in Kaohsiung since 2018. (= for eight years)

traps.wrong: I have lived here since 5 years.
traps.correct: I have lived here for 5 years.
traps.reason: 5 years 是時間段，必須搭配 for，不可用 since。

dialogue.speaker: Maya

dialogue.zh: 還不知道。找到它的學生正在詢問辦公室。

checklist: 我能精確分清 since 搭時間點與 for 搭時間段
我熟記常考動詞過去分詞 p.p. 形式

extra.title: 過去式與現在完成式：時間如何選？
extra.rule: 過去式把事件放在已結束的過去時間；現在完成式用 have / has + 過去分詞，連結過去與現在。不是看到中文「已經」就選完成式。過去簡單式將事件鎖定在已結束的過去斷點（如 yesterday, last week, in 2020）；這種時態本身不交代結果是否延續至今；現在完成式站在現在回望過去，表達經驗、持續至現在的狀態，或剛完成且影響現在的動作。
pairs: 昨天弄丟：時間已結束，用 lost。
現在還受到影響，例如目前沒鑰匙可用。
She has lived here for three years.
住了三年，通常表示目前仍住這裡。
extra.trap: 錯：I have seen her yesterday. → I saw her yesterday. 完成式與明確結束的 yesterday 不相配。錯：She has arrived since two hours. → She arrived two hours ago. 或 She has been here for two hours. since 接起點，for 接長度；arrive 是抵達的瞬間動作，不能只改成 has arrived for two hours 來表示持續停留。
extra.model: I finished my report yesterday. I have known Amy for five years. 檢查：第一句有已結束時間；第二句用 have + known，for 後接時間長度。

extra.title: 完成式：先前事件與參照點
extra.rule: 完成式用 have + 過去分詞，將先前發生的事連到現在、過去或未來的參照點；不只是「做完」而已。

rows: 過去遺失，現在沒有鑰匙。
We have lived here for three years.
The bus had left when I arrived.
By Friday, we will have finished the report.

extra.trap: 明確已結束的時間 yesterday 通常用過去式，不寫 I have seen him yesterday。since 接起點，for 接長度。

guide.motivation: make, have, let 後面受詞補詞接原形動詞！使役動詞與授予動詞是會考改錯與選擇題年年必考的黃金指標題。

tips.title: 三大使役動詞接原形動詞法則
tips.formula: make (強迫) / have (要求) / let (允許) + 受詞 + 原形動詞
tips.body: 使役動詞後方的受詞補詞「絕對不能加 to」，一律接原形動詞！但在被動語態時需還原 to (He was made to clean...)。
tips.example: The coach made the players run ten laps around the field.

traps.wrong: He made me to clean the room.
traps.correct: He made me clean the room.
traps.reason: 使役動詞 make 後面直接接原形動詞 clean，嚴禁加 to。

guide.motivation: The girl (who) I saw yesterday is my classmate. 關係代名詞什麼時候可以省略？介系詞何時能提前？搞懂這套規則，長句結構一覽無遺。

tips.title: 關係代名詞主格 vs 受格省略辨別法
tips.formula: 先還原子句確認缺口；限定子句中作受詞的關係代名詞常可省略，非限定子句及前置介系詞後不可省略
tips.body: The book (which) you bought is good. vs The man who lives next door is a doctor.
tips.example: The song (that) she sang touched everyone's heart.

traps.wrong: The girl speaks English well is my sister.
traps.correct: The girl who speaks English well is my sister.
traps.reason: 關代當主格絕對不可省略，否則全句會出現兩個主要動詞。

guide.goal: 國中教育會考精熟級 (A++) 雙向細目：現在完成式、被動語態、關係代名詞子句、名詞子句與多模態圖表題。
guide.motivation: Do you know where the station is? 間接問句與附加問句在日常溝通中代表禮貌與求證，會考每兩年必考一次直述句語序辨析！

tips.title: 間接問句直述語序萬能公式
tips.formula: 疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞 (Wh- + S + V)
tips.body: 間接問句嵌入主句後，不再用倒裝問句語序，必須恢復為直述句語序！
tips.example: Can you tell me what time the train departs (不是 does the train depart ❌)?

traps.wrong: Do you know where does he live?
traps.correct: Do you know where he lives?
traps.reason: 間接問句內部必須恢復直述句語序，不可保留助動詞 does。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The museum closes at five, doesn't it?

dialogue.en: Could you tell me where the information desk is?

dialogue.zh: 在入口旁。我們去那裡問。

我能熟練寫出前肯後否、前否後肯的附加問句
guide.level: A2++ / Pre-B1 (會考 A++ 標竿)

extra.title: 引導式討論：表達意見、回應同學、舉一反三
extra.rule: 討論有三個動作：①說意見＋理由：I think…, because… / In my opinion, … ②回應同學：I agree with Amy. / That’s a good point, but… / Can you give an example? ③舉一反三：把別人的想法延伸到新例子：That also works for… 分辨事實與意見：事實可以查證（The library opens at 8.），意見帶有判斷字（I think、maybe、best、should）。主動參與、不怕說錯，比說得完美更重要。
pairs: In my opinion, we should have more P.E. classes, because exercise helps us focus.
I agree with Ken. Also, it’s good for our health.
That’s a good point, but some students may feel tired.
有禮貌地提出不同看法。
extra.trap: 常見錯誤：只說 I agree. 沒有理由；或把意見說成事實（Math is the most boring subject.），應改為 I think math is boring.。
extra.model: In my opinion, students should use phones only for learning. For example, we can look up words quickly. That’s a good point that phones can be distracting, but teachers can set clear rules. 檢查：有意見、理由、回應三部分嗎？

guide.goal: 國中教育會考精熟級 (A++) 雙向細目：現在完成式、被動語態、關係代名詞子句、名詞子句與多模態圖表題。
guide.motivation: 會考閱讀長篇化、圖表化！作者在文章中未明說的弦外之音，該如何從蛛絲馬跡中合理推論？

tips.title: 代名詞指代與推論三大鐵證
tips.formula: 上下文指涉相容 + 文本證據支持 + 排除過度推論；最近的名詞不一定是指涉對象
tips.body: 遇到 What does 'it' refer to? 先看前一句話的主詞或受詞，確認性別與單複數。
tips.example: The solar panel was broken. Replacing IT took three technicians a full day.

traps.wrong: 憑自己的常識猜測答案，沒有在原文找證據。
traps.correct: 每一道題目都在原文圈出對應的證據句。
traps.reason: 會考評量文本依據，未依據文章者必為誘答陷阱。

words.zh: 出席的;當前的;現在式的

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: The notice says, 'Leave it at the front desk.' What does it refer to?
dialogue.zh: 通知寫「把它留在櫃檯」，it 指什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Look at the sentence before it. It mentions the room key.
dialogue.zh: 看前一句，裡面提到房間鑰匙。

dialogue.speaker: Maya
dialogue.en: So we return the key, but keep the receipt?
dialogue.zh: 所以我們交回鑰匙，保留收據？

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Exactly. The last sentence says to keep the receipt for our records.
dialogue.zh: 對。最後一句說收據留作紀錄。

checklist: 我能找到代名詞 it, they, this 在前文的明確指代對象
做推論題時，我必定在原文圈出至少一句支撐證據
guide.level: A2++ / Pre-B1 (會考 A++ 標竿)

extra.title: 聽力記要點：對話、故事與廣播
extra.rule: 記要點不是逐字抄寫，而是抓「答案會用到的資訊」：Who（誰）、What（做什麼）、When（何時）、Where（哪裡）、Why/How（原因、方式）。聽之前先看題目或標題預測會聽到什麼；聽的時候只寫關鍵字、數字和縮寫（Mon、3:30、→ 表結果）；聽完立刻用完整句子補齊，並用自己的話轉述：He said that… / The announcement says… 廣播常重複兩次，第二次專門用來檢查數字和更正資訊。
pairs: 把一段廣播濃縮成關鍵字。
The coach said the practice would start at 3:30 in the gym.
用箭頭記下更正的資訊。
extra.trap: 常見錯誤：想把每個字都寫下來，結果漏掉重要數字；或只記第一次聽到的時間，忘了後面的更正（Sorry, I mean…）。
extra.model: 要點：Sat / beach clean-up / 9 a.m. / bring gloves / free lunch。轉述：The video says a beach clean-up will be held on Saturday at 9 a.m. Volunteers should bring gloves. Lunch is free. 檢查：轉述有沒有包含時間、地點和要做的事？

guide.motivation: 會考壓軸題：一張火車班表 + 一封確認電子郵件 + 一則氣象預報！跨文本互證能力是拿到 A++ 滿分的最關鍵試金石。

tips.title: 跨文本多模態資訊交叉比對法
tips.formula: 文本一 (時間限制) + 文本二 (預算或條件) ➔ 交集出唯一正確選項
tips.body: 克漏字注意篇章轉折詞 (However, Therefore, On the other hand, As a result)。
tips.example: The train leaves at 8:15, but ticket prices double after 8:00.

traps.wrong: 只看第一篇文本就急著下定論選答案。
traps.correct: 同時檢查第二篇文本是否有取消、特價或時間變更限制。
traps.reason: 會考多文本題目常在第二篇文本中設置限制或取消條款。

dialogue.speaker: Ben

dialogue.speaker: Maya

dialogue.zh: 喔，而且圖表用的是百分比，不是學生人數。

dialogue.speaker: Ben
dialogue.en: Right. Let's compare the same year and the same unit before we answer.
dialogue.zh: 對。作答前先比較同一年和同一單位。

k.past-perfect.tip.title: 過去式與現在完成式：時間如何選？
k.past-perfect.tip.formula: 看懂「已結束的過去」與「連到現在的經驗或狀態」，徹底擺脫中文「已經」的干擾。
k.past-perfect.tip.body: 過去式把事件放在已結束的過去時間；現在完成式用 have / has + 過去分詞，連結過去與現在。不是看到中文「已經」就選完成式。過去簡單式將事件鎖定在已結束的過去斷點（如 yesterday, last week, in 2020）；這種時態本身不交代結果是否延續至今；現在完成式站在現在回望過去，表達經驗、持續至現在的狀態，或剛完成且影響現在的動作。
k.past-perfect.tip.example: I lost my key yesterday. / I have lost my key.

k.past-perfect.1.why: last Sunday 是結束的過去；visited 是過去式。have visited 不搭這個時間，have visit 缺過去分詞。
k.past-perfect.1.hint: 過去式用在已結束的過去時間（如 yesterday、two days ago）；現在完成式用 have / has + 過去分詞，連結過去與現在。不是看到中文「已經」就選完成式。

k.past-perfect.2.prompt: Mia still works here. She ___ here since 2022.
k.past-perfect.2.why: still 和 since 指向延續至今，選 has worked。單純 worked 無法表達此處的持續關係；is work 結構錯誤。
k.past-perfect.2.hint: 過去式用在已結束的過去時間（如 yesterday、two days ago）；現在完成式用 have / has + 過去分詞，連結過去與現在。不是看到中文「已經」就選完成式。

gr.perfect.prompt: She ___ here since 2020 and still lives here.
gr.perfect.why: since 2020 加上至今仍居住，使用現在完成式。
gr.perfect.hint: 完成式用 have + 過去分詞，將先前發生的事連到現在、過去或未來的參照點；不只是「做完」而已。

k.guided-discussion.tip.title: 引導式討論：表達意見、回應同學、舉一反三
k.guided-discussion.tip.formula: 在小組討論中用簡易英語表達意見、提出理由、回應他人，並分辨事實與意見。
k.guided-discussion.tip.body: 討論有三個動作：①說意見＋理由：I think…, because… / In my opinion, … ②回應同學：I agree with Amy. / That’s a good point, but… / Can you give an example? ③舉一反三：把別人的想法延伸到新例子：That also works for… 分辨事實與意見：事實可以查證（The library opens at 8.），意見帶有判斷字（I think、maybe、best、should）。主動參與、不怕說錯，比…
k.guided-discussion.tip.example: In my opinion, we should have more P.E. classes, because exercise helps us focus. / I agree with Ken. Also, it’s good for our health.

options: I think our school needs more trees.
k.guided-discussion.1.answer: I think our school needs more trees.
k.guided-discussion.1.why: I think 表示主觀意見；其他句子可以查證。
k.guided-discussion.1.hint: 意見是個人的想法或感覺，別人可能不同意；事實則可以被查證。

options: That’s a good point, but I see it differently.
k.guided-discussion.2.answer: That’s a good point, but I see it differently.
k.guided-discussion.2.why: 先肯定再提出不同看法，是有禮貌的回應方式。
k.guided-discussion.2.hint: 想想哪一種說法能尊重對方，同時表達自己不同的看法。

d.diag-0608.prompt: I can't remember where I ___ my house keys last night.

d.diag-0608.why: 正裝語序：where + 主詞 (I) + 過去動詞 (put)。 間接問句正裝選 put。
d.diag-0608.topic: 間接問句之疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞正裝語序

d.diag-0609.prompt: The teacher asked Emily why she ___ her project assignment late.

d.diag-0609.why: 正裝語序：why + 主詞 (she) + 過去動詞 (submitted)。 正裝語序選 submitted。
d.diag-0609.topic: 間接問句之疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞正裝語序

d.diag-0610.prompt: Could you show me how I ___ operate this new microwave oven?

d.diag-0610.why: 正裝語序：how + 主詞 (I) + 助動詞 (can) + 原形動詞 (operate)。 主詞在助動詞前選 can。
d.diag-0610.topic: 間接問句之疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞正裝語序

d.diag-0611.prompt: I am not sure ___ the typhoon will make landfall tomorrow morning.

d.diag-0611.why: not sure 後表示「是否」的不確定名詞子句，引導詞使用 whether 或 if。 表「是否」選 whether。
d.diag-0611.topic: whether / if 引導之名詞子句

d.diag-0612.prompt: The teacher asked Tony ___ he had finished his math assignment.
d.diag-0612.hint: 題意：老師詢問 Tony 他是否已經完成了數學作業。
d.diag-0612.why: asked 後引導是否完成的名詞子句，使用 if 或 whether。 詢問是否用 if。

d.diag-0613.prompt: ___ we can hold the outdoor sports day depends entirely on the weather.
d.diag-0613.hint: 題意：我們能否舉辦室外運動會完全取決於天氣狀況。
d.diag-0613.why: 位於句首引導名詞子句當全句主詞時，只能使用 Whether，不可使用 if！ 句首當主詞只能用 Whether，不可用 if。
d.diag-0613.topic: whether / if 引導之名詞子句

d.diag-0614.prompt: Leo has to decide ___ to accept the scholarship or stay in Taiwan.

d.diag-0614.topic: whether / if 引導之名詞子句

d.diag-0617.topic: whether / if 引導之名詞子句

k.listen-take-notes.tip.title: 聽力記要點：對話、故事與廣播
k.listen-take-notes.tip.formula: 聽日常對話、簡易故事、廣播或影片時，用關鍵字記下人、事、時、地、物，並能轉述。
k.listen-take-notes.tip.body: 記要點不是逐字抄寫，而是抓「答案會用到的資訊」：Who（誰）、What（做什麼）、When（何時）、Where（哪裡）、Why/How（原因、方式）。聽之前先看題目或標題預測會聽到什麼；聽的時候只寫關鍵字、數字和縮寫（Mon、3:30、→ 表結果）；聽完立刻用完整句子補齊，並用自己的話轉述：He said that… / The announcement says… 廣播常重複兩次，第二次專門用來檢查數字和更正資訊。
k.listen-take-notes.tip.example: Note: Fri / 3:30 / gym / bring shoes / The coach said the practice would start at 3:30 in the gym.

k.listen-take-notes.1.hint: 記重點不是逐字抄寫，而是抓答案會用到的資訊：Who（誰）、What（做什麼）、When（何時）、Where（哪裡）。

k.listen-take-notes.2.prompt: Which note style is most useful while listening?

k.listen-take-notes.2.hint: 想想哪一種筆記方式能跟上說話的速度，又能留下重點。

d.diag-0702.prompt: We arrived at the airport on time ___ the severe traffic congestion.

d.diag-0702.topic: 介系詞 despite / in spite of 與連接詞 although 辨析

d.diag-0703.prompt: ___ he had trained diligently for months, Tony did not qualify for the final.

d.diag-0703.topic: 介系詞 despite / in spite of 與連接詞 although 辨析

d.diag-0704.prompt: The resilient climber reached the mountain peak ___ the freezing winds.

d.diag-0704.topic: 介系詞 despite / in spite of 與連接詞 although 辨析

d.diag-0705.prompt: ___ feeling extremely exhausted after the hike, Emily helped prepare dinner.

d.diag-0705.topic: 介系詞 despite / in spite of 與連接詞 although 辨析

d.diag-0706.prompt: The flight took off safely ___ thick fog was covering the runway.

d.diag-0706.topic: 介系詞 despite / in spite of 與連接詞 although 辨析

d.diag-0707.prompt: ___ having little formal musical training, Sam composed a stunning symphony.

d.diag-0707.topic: 介系詞 despite / in spite of 與連接詞 although 辨析

d.diag-0721.prompt: Electric cars produce zero tailpipe emissions. ___, generating electricity still creates environmental impacts.
d.diag-0721.hint: 前句：電動車不會排放廢氣；後句：發電仍會對環境造成影響。判斷兩句是補充、因果還是轉折關係。
d.diag-0721.why: 前後句語意形成鮮明轉折對比，轉折副詞使用 However（副詞以逗號隔開）。 語意轉折選 However。

d.diag-0722.prompt: Regular exercise strengthens cardiovascular health. ___, it boosts mental well-being and elevates mood.
d.diag-0722.hint: 前句：規律運動能增進心血管健康；後句：運動也能促進心理健康、改善心情。判斷兩句是補充、因果還是轉折關係。
d.diag-0722.why: 後句在健康益處上作進一步補充遞進，連接副詞使用 Furthermore（此外）。 補充遞進關係選 Furthermore。
d.diag-0722.topic: 會考克漏字篇章銜接與轉折

d.diag-0723.prompt: The company suffered enormous financial losses during the recession. ___, it had to lay off numerous employees.
d.diag-0723.hint: 前句：公司在經濟衰退期間嚴重虧損；後句：公司必須裁員。判斷兩句的邏輯關係。
d.diag-0723.why: 前後為因果承接關係（因巨虧故裁員），副詞使用 Therefore（因此）。 因果承接選 Therefore。
d.diag-0723.topic: 會考克漏字篇章銜接與轉折

d.diag-0724.prompt: We must leave for the railway station immediately. ___, we will miss our scheduled express train.

d.diag-0724.why: Otherwise 表「否則、要不然」（引出如果不這樣做將導致的負面後果）。 表示否則選 Otherwise。
d.diag-0724.topic: 會考克漏字篇章銜接與轉折

d.diag-0725.prompt: The modern museum exhibits rare ancient treasures. ___, admission is completely free for all students.
d.diag-0725.hint: 前句：博物館展出珍貴的古代寶物；後句：學生可以完全免費入場。判斷兩句的邏輯關係。
d.diag-0725.why: 在參觀優點上作正面遞進補充，使用 In addition（此外）。 正面補充選 In addition。
d.diag-0725.topic: 會考克漏字篇章銜接與轉折

d.diag-0726.prompt: Tony practiced tirelessly for the speech tournament. ___, he secured first place in the finals.
d.diag-0726.hint: 前句：Tony 為演講比賽不停練習；後句：他在決賽拿下第一名。判斷兩句的邏輯關係。
d.diag-0726.why: 前後為努力與成功結果之承接，使用 As a result（結果、因而）。 結果承接選 As a result。
d.diag-0726.topic: 會考克漏字篇章銜接與轉折

d.diag-0727.prompt: Repairing the old building would cost a lot of money. ___, the city government decided to restore it.
d.diag-0727.hint: 前句：修復這棟老建築要花很多錢；後句：市政府決定修復它。判斷兩句是補充、因果還是轉折關係。
d.diag-0727.why: 前句說修復很花錢，後句卻仍決定修復，形成讓步轉折，使用 Nevertheless（儘管如此）。正確答案為「Nevertheless」。
d.diag-0727.topic: 會考克漏字篇章銜接與轉折

d.diag-0728.prompt: You should eat plenty of vegetables. ___, you should drink enough water every day.
d.diag-0728.hint: 前句：你應該多吃蔬菜；後句：你每天也應該喝足夠的水。判斷兩句的邏輯關係。
d.diag-0728.why: 前後兩句都是健康建議，後句補充另一項建議，使用 In addition（此外）。正確答案為「In addition」。
d.diag-0728.topic: 會考克漏字篇章銜接與轉折

d.diag-0729.prompt: Plastic bags do not decompose easily in nature. ___, they pose a catastrophic threat to marine wildlife.

d.diag-0729.why: 不可分解（因）造成海洋威脅（果），選 Consequently（因此結果）。 因果後果選 Consequently。

d.diag-0730.prompt: The school didn't cancel the sports meet. ___, the organizers relocated all activities indoors.

d.diag-0731.prompt: NOTICE: 'Trespassers will be prosecuted.' What does this sign mean?

Visitors can park here for free.
People entering without permission will face legal action.
The building is open for public tours.
d.diag-0731.answer: People entering without permission will face legal action.

d.diag-0731.why: 法律警示牌句意解析：未經許可進入將面臨法律究辦。 正確選項為「People entering without permission will face legal action.」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

On a television screen in an office
Near a swimming pool or newly mopped corridor

d.diag-0733.prompt: ANNOUNCEMENT: 'All flights delayed due to dense fog.' What caused the flight delay?

d.diag-0734.prompt: CHART NOTE: 'Sales surged by 40% in Q3.' What does 'surged' imply in this context?

d.diag-0735.prompt: METRO NOTICE: 'Mind the gap between the train and the platform.' What is the advice?

Leave your baggage on the platform.
Step carefully over the opening when boarding.
Do not look at the tracks below.
d.diag-0735.answer: Step carefully over the opening when boarding.

d.diag-0735.why: 大眾運輸警示：小心跨越空隙。 正確選項為「Step carefully over the opening when boarding.」。其他選項在詞性、語義或邏輯方向上不符題幹需求。

d.diag-0736.prompt: FOOD LABEL: 'Best before October 15, 2026.' What should consumers understand?

The item cannot be opened until October 15.
The product maintains optimal quality before this date.

d.diag-0737.prompt: RESTAURANT SIGN: 'Please wait to be seated.' What are patrons expected to do?

Find any empty table and sit down immediately.
Go directly to the kitchen to place an order.
Pay the bill before entering the dining area.

They will be rented to other students.

d.diag-0739.prompt: MUSEUM SIGN: 'Flash photography strictly prohibited.' What action is forbidden?

Taking pictures with the camera flash turned on.
